test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an exhibition, seven brands have put up their stalls in horizontal line and facing in same direction. The seven brands that have put up a stall include: A, B, L, P, R, T and Z. L, which is third to the left of B, is at one end. A is between B and Z. T is to the immediate right of R. R is fourth to the right of L. Which brand is displayed to the immediate right of T?
solution:
**Seven brands: **A, B, L, P, R, T and Z.

1) L which is third to the left of B, is at one end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9176f3cb23e539a659f1a5c64c15266e0c6e362e78c458807bbb39cf2d0a684.png] 

2) R is fourth to the right of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4923efdcd75bcbcab215a818a756e6bc0149760b7a19f5265c6fc3ecb48c222d.png] 

3) A is between B and Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d3575360ca002444a812178a57b5be266ff23dc0fd9f4a2773d641f6ad19aff.png] 

4) T is immediate right of R.

5) One position left for P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb5747763b7f06ed51d2819884f5a8d2bae414b082435a33bceafe4e928ec7c4.png] 

Clearly, P brand is displayed to the immediate right of T

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**
